versions.changelog:
- 更新描述，突出创意视频制作、图生视频、动态内容生成等通用场景
- 精简并调整 skill 触发场景描述，弱化“分镜师项目”专用语境
- 其余文档结构和API用法保持一致

- Initial release of the cn-video-gen skill for AI-powered video generation.
- Supports Tongyi Wanxiang (Wan2.6, text-to-video and image-to-video) and Kling V2 platforms.
- Designed for storyboard-driven projects, creative video production, and image-to-video scenarios.
- Guides on video generation workflow: requirements gathering, image upload, async video generation, and delivery via Feishu.
- Includes prompt tips, API parameter references, and cost-control recommendations.
